left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients attending a preoperative visit  [AND] at the Center for Comprehensive Gynecology who will undergo surgery

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Not able to comprehend and sign a written consent
  -  Patients with a history of allergy to iodides
  -  Patients history of renal failure  [OR] or uremia, [AND]  and those on dialysis
